metrics.profile_summary: Marketing professional with approximately two years of experience and an MBA in Marketing. Specialized in lead generation, digital campaigns, and client relationship management with a strong foundation in digital marketing tools.

experience.description: Drives customer acquisition through outbound marketing, digital campaigns, and LinkedIn networking. Manages HubSpot CRM and executes corporate events to increase brand visibility.
Handled client relations, generated leads via Upwork, and managed content publishing on WordPress and email marketing.
Managed outreach to potential partners and assisted in the creation of partnership proposals and agreements.

strengths: Strong lead generation and CRM experience
weaknesses: No explicit mention of Meta Business Suite
Lack of documented experience with UTM tracking and social media scheduling tools
evaluation.summary: The candidate meets the educational requirements and has the minimum required experience. While specific social media management tools aren't listed, her MBA and digital marketing certification suggest she can quickly adapt to the technical requirements.
